name: PS2 Pnacher
tagline: Applying Pnaches directly to PS2 ISOs.
blurb: PS2 Pnacher allows you to apply various patches like widescreen patches or cheats directly onto a compatible PS2 ISO.
description:
PS2 Pnacher allows you to apply various patches like widescreen patches or cheats directly onto a compatible PS2 ISO.

Simply select your PS2 ISO file and the corresponding patch file (pnach) and hit "Patch!"

This program was written with the main goal to offer a Linux compatible counterpart to the original PS2 Patch Engine.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
